message:

W2's report: {"refunds_applied": [{"order_id": 192, "amount_cents": 3148}, {"order_id": 193, "amount_cents": 9581}], "refunds_not_applied": [{"order_id": 194, "amount_cents": 5972, "error": "write failed: disk I/O error, refund not recorded (failed on 3 attempts; list_refunds confirms it is absent)"}]}

hold_reason: Refund for order 194 (customer birch, amount_cents 5972) was not recorded: W2 reports a disk I/O write failure after 3 attempts, and list_refunds confirms only refunds for orders 192 and 193 exist. Paying birch's net balance now would overpay by 5972 cents. Needs the 194 refund recorded (or confirmed not due) before payouts run.
